notes: Expectations target the shipped catalogs/baseline/sites.sqlite index (8 snapshots, no network, no clone). Re-run the command after rebuilding the baseline to refresh the numbers.

A positive case is a hit at rank k when, for any parsed record of the case, a location in the top-k has expect.repo_id (when given), a path ending with expect.path_suffix, and a line within expect.line_tolerance of expect.line (when expect.line is given).
A negative case must return index_miss=true with zero locations. Any returned location is counted as a false positive, which means the minimum accepted score admitted non-distinctive evidence.
kind=line scores a single log line, so the case does not depend on log-file layout. kind=log scores every record of a committed fixture log.
Notes on individual cases record why the expectation is fair; read them before retuning anything.
